units.source_text: 斋宫告别时，天皇亲手取栉加在她的额发上，并叮嘱她“勿再回京”。

en.t: When the Saigu took her leave, the emperor personally took a comb and placed it in the hair above her forehead, admonishing her, "Do not return to the capital again."

units.source_text: 因为她若回京，必是天皇易代。

en.t: For if she were to return to the capital, it would necessarily mean that the reign had passed to another emperor.

units.source_text: 梳头时只有去（向下梳），而无回（从发梢向上梳），故以栉加额也。

en.t: When combing the hair, there is only going away, that is, combing downward, and no returning, that is, combing upward from the tips; therefore the comb is placed at the forehead.
